name: Clock Rotom (CobbleEffort form)
look: a round pendulum wall clock with a blue rim, lens eyes on its face, orange hands and a blue pendulum
entry: It spins its hands back and forth and makes the people who watch it lose track of time.
how: Use a Clock Hand on your Rotom (craft it round a Cell Battery; needs Mega Showdown); its Rotom Catalogue cycles through this form too. Learns Roar of Time in this form.
